english_title: Your Shadow is With You, Does it help You? How About Wealth Then?
notes: Your own shadow is so much with you; yet it offers no shelter to you. How is it then you cling on to possessions? It is vain hope that it will afford you security. With your body, life too departs. Seek that which imparts light to all.

english_title: The Bee Stores Honey Only to be Appropriated by Others; So is Your Hoarded Wealth
notes: The bee gathers honey industriously. But someone else steals it and enjoys. So it is with your wealth.

english_title: Wealth is a Flood that Ebbs and Flows
english_translation:
Weigh well the pros and cons, and having weighed, waver not.
Lose not your bearings, caught in wealth's eddy;
Fling aside the transient trappings of earthly treasures
And thus when the Pale Sergeant comes, for the great leap be ready.
notes: Wealth comes like the flood of waters and flows away. Put not your trust in it. Fling it aside and think of the Lord. You can defy death in triumphant joy.

english_title: Wealth is a Boat in Dangerous Waters
english_translation:
How fast we cling to stock of cattle and riches gay
Less stable even than the boat which midstream upturns!
Likewise a bond ties the body to soul,
When it will give away no one knows.

However much of treasure we may leave,
Our wife, children, brothers and sisters will only exclaim "What has he left for us?"
If we devote our life merely for such treasure,
At the end when we are in agony no one will come for help.

english_title: All Your Wealth Cannot Bribe Death Away
english_translation:
When the vital spark leaves this mortal mould,
Bribe there is none to lure it back; think, think of the Lord;
Death's loyal servants on restless mission bent,
Do nothing consider that with hot breath you pulse.
notes: When life takes its flight from the body, think of the Lord. You cannot bribe death to stay his hands. The Lord alone shall be our refuge then.

english_title: Rising Sun Sets; Glowing Youth Fades
english_translation:
They see the sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
Yet blind of eye, the truth they ne'er apprehend.
The tender calf grows, fattens for a while and dies;
But this wonder-pageant of the world they do not comprehend.
notes: Morning after morning the sun rises in the east; blazes through the noonday sky and sets in the western horizon. The tender calf grows into the fat bull and in a few years dies. They see all these; yet they do not realise how very ephemeral youth is!

english_title: Even a Life-time is not Enough to Know Him
english_translation:
The years roll on; but none the Lord in his bosom holds,
None to probe and perceive Him profound;
Even if Time's thread be to the utmost stretched,
Still they know not the spark that kindles all the lamps around.

english_title: While Life Still Throbs, Fix Your Mind on the Lord
english_translation:
When youth had danced its way to palsied age,
Scarce the chance to fill the years with good deeds more and more;
So while life still throbs, fix your mind on Nandi,
Into whose spreading locks
The holy waters of Ganga eternally pour.

english_title: Youth is Sugar-cane; Age is Nux Vomica
notes: In youth, man is the cynosure of women's eyes; but when palsied age advances, he becomes an object of repulsion to them. He who was like sugarcane to them now becomes bitter nux-vomica. Such is youth's brief dazzle of glory.

english_title: Time Fleets, So Centre yourself on the Lord
english_translation:
The boy grows to youth, and youth as surely to old age decays,
But time's changes teach them not that nothing abides;
And so, in ceaseless pursuit, His Sacred Feet, I seek
Him who, transcending this world, beyond the universe presides.
notes: From the cradle to the grave man passes through the seven stages of life; and none of the seven stages lasts. Youth passes into age and then to senile decay.

english_title: Think of the Lord Through Time's Cycles
english_translation:
Day after day we wake to greet the morn,
Day after day we seek the nightly couch;
Even though God, good and great, may frown in wrath,
True devotees ne'er miss His great Love's guarantee.
notes: Man rises with the sun and goes to sleep at night. Day after day, night after night this happens and thus life fleets away.

english_title: The Body Perishes with the senses
english_translation:
The five senses dwell inside the body,
They may leave it any time,
If the five senses become unsteady,
The body which is the container of the senses also perishes.

english_title: Know Him the Eye of the eye
english_translation:
We perceive only the external sun and the eye with which we see it,
We do not realise the Lord within who stimulates both the eye and the sun,
Not knowing Him we pass from heaven to hell again and again,
We pass away in the spring of our youth.
